g.text: Fig. 7 context — actual single-bank behavioral spectrum
N=256 · Fs=5 MS/s · Fin=97.65625 kHz (bin 5) · input −1 dBFS
Noise and AZ OFF; behavioral model, not the paper’s 20k-point measurement.
SNR 109.78 dB · SNDR 109.35 dB · SFDR 122.27 dB · THD -119.53 dBc · ENOB 17.87 bit
Rectangular window · one-sided bins 1–128 · DC excluded · H2–H10 separated for SNR
P: A0=10000 · UGB=1.2 GHz · Cf=0.864 pF · sample/DAC tau=0 · guard=0
